response.evidence: First, Build your container by running the following command... docker build -t <your-astro-image-name> . This will output an image, which you can run locally or deploy to a platform of your choice. Second, To run your image as a local container, use the following command... docker run -p <local-port>:<container-port> <your-astro-image-name>
response.rationale: The Recipe section instructs building an image named <your-astro-image-name> with docker build, then running that same image as a local container with docker run. So the image run locally is the one produced by the preceding build step, not the Alpine variant or the Node base image.
